test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends Richa, Shobhna, Urmila, Swarna, Purnima, and Kavya, are sitting on a bench in the park. They all are facing south. Only four persons are sitting between Purnima and Richa. Swarna is sitting third to the left of Purnima. Richa and Swarna are immediate neighbour of Kavya. Purnima and Shobhna are immediate neighbours of Urmila. Who sits fourth to the left of Urmila?
solution: Given: Six friends Richa, Shobhna, Urmila, Swarna, Purnima, and Kavya, are sitting on a bench in the park. They all are facing south. 1) Only four persons are sitting between Purnima and Richa. 2) Swarna is sitting third to the left of Purnima. 3) Richa and Swarna are immediate neighbour of Kavya.
